answer: Price each identity to a scarce external hardware anchor that must sign a fresh cipher proof every epoch, and let standing open petal by petal like a lotus only as already-established peers in separate funding clusters co-sign audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its endorsements fold back and never span distinct clusters, never mooring at the harbor of genuine standing. Honest moors once; a farm must forge a distinct anchor per head and climb anew, so cost rises linearly with every fake.
